response.bodyText: {"claims":[{"text":"Electric vehicle batteries must be replaced every three years at a cost of $25,000.","claimant":"Social media posts","claimDate":"2026-08-14T00:00:00Z","claimReview":[{"publisher":{"name":"PolitiFact","site":"politifact.com"},"url":"https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2026/aug/20/social-media/ev-battery-lifespan-claim/","title":"No, electric vehicle batteries do not require replacement every three years","reviewDate":"2026-08-20T16:00:00Z","textualRating":"False","languageCode":"en"}]},{"text":"Cold weather permanently cuts EV battery capacity in half after one winter.","claimant":"Viral video","claimDate":"2026-01-19T00:00:00Z","claimReview":[{"publisher":{"name":"Reuters Fact Check","site":"reuters.com"},"url":"https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/ev-battery-winter-range-temporary-2026/","title":"Fact Check: Freezing temperatures temporarily reduce EV range, not permanent battery capacity","reviewDate":"2026-01-25T12:30:00Z","textualRating":"Misleading","languageCode":"en"}]},{"text":"Electric vehicle batteries cannot be recycled and are all dumped in landfills.","claimant":"Blog post","claimDate":"2026-05-03T00:00:00Z","claimReview":[{"publisher":{"name":"AP Fact Check","site":"apnews.com"},"url":"https://apnews.com/article/fact-check-ev-battery-recycling-2026","title":"EV lithium-ion batteries are widely repurposed and recycled for critical minerals","reviewDate":"2026-05-07T14:15:00Z","textualRating":"False","languageCode":"en"}]}],"nextPageToken":"CAIQAA"}
